column2: A mermaid demon sealed away long ago. Its true power has not yet awakened.[end]
A mysterious demon sealed away in ancient times for tempting humans. Even as a zombie, its power is fearsome.[end]
An evil demon that died once and came back as a vampire. It fights Kresnik, who hunts it, again and again.[end]
A cheerful demon that's good at magic. It calls a violent arm out of its hat... but that arm keeps punching it.[end]
An evil demon that kidnaps and eats human children. A great whistler, it lures travelers with the sound.[end]
A giant demon that lives in the sea. It keeps getting bigger and bigger, and they say it will grow bigger than the world.[end]
A catlike demon said to fall from the sky with the lightning. It's cute, but touch it and you'll get zapped.[end]
A watermelon-striped, piglike demon said to live in watermelon fields. A glutton that swallows humans in its field whole.[end]
A nimble demon that runs faster than the eye can follow. No demon can beat it in a race.[end]
A vicious bull-shaped demon with incredible strength. Its iron club sends foes and friends alike flying.[end]
A fearsome demon that appears at night. It brings the gods a present inside an egg, but nobody knows what's in it.[end]
A ship demon that comes every day as the sun rises. It can cross the border between this world and the next.[end]
An evil demon that carries sickness on hot winds. Once you catch its sickness, normal methods can't cure it.[end]
A very evil, fish-shaped demon that lives in cold places and spreads terrible sickness through the water.[end]
A mysterious demon that taught humans weapons, magic and makeup. Nobody knows if it is trying to help them.[end]
An evil demon that lives inside rocks in cold lands. It looks like a dinosaur with six legs.[end]
A god of good fortune who brings business success. He has apparently been battling the sea bream he fishes for thousands of years.[end]
A demon that lives in snowy places. Space out and it'll possess you, but sometimes it helps humans in trouble.[end]
A mouse demon that lives inside volcanoes and is on fire itself. Try to set a Kaso's fur alight and it never burns.[end]
A mysterious demon rumored to be very powerful. It gives humans trials, and those who pass them gain new power.[end]
One of the ogre brothers. It has a mysterious gourd that sucks in anyone who answers when their name is called.[end]
A sad demon that was meant to be a doll with a soul, but failed and ended up with an incomplete body.[end]
A little ogre demon always thinking up mischief. If you're not careful, you'll fall for its pranks.[end]
The soul of an evil demon defeated by humans. One alone is weak, so they always gang up before they attack.[end]
An evil demon that spread sickness by controlling hot winds. It woke from a long seal, but its power is not yet complete.[end]
A scary demon that kidnapped and ate children. Its seal is broken, but not all of its power has returned.[end]
A nimble tiger demon sealed away long ago for its misdeeds. Its true power has not yet awakened.[end]
